_comment: Templates for generated statements (docs/SIMULATION.md 'Statements in interviews'). Variables: {who} {detail} {place} {time}. Australian English, 1950s country voice.

was_told: I was told {detail}. Only hearsay, mind.
whereabouts: I was {place} at {time}, as I told you.

denial: I saw nothing, dear. Not a thing.
false_time: I was back by {time}. Not a minute after.

omit: I don't know anything about that.
